violations.requirement: The range index must be in bounds (4 <= len)
violations.explanation: The code assumes the line starts with "@@ -", but parse_hunks is also called on a line from next(PatchReader::mv, ..), which accepts any line. Those calls come from parse_minus and the rename/copy path. A line shorter than 4 bytes, such as an empty line, makes get_unchecked(4..) out of bounds.

violations.requirement: The range index must be in bounds (start.len() <= len)
violations.explanation: get_file_op only checks starts_with("new file") (8 bytes) or starts_with("deleted file") (12 bytes). It then calls parse_mode with the longer prefixes "new file mode " (14 bytes) and "deleted file mode " (18 bytes). A line such as "new file" is shorter than the prefix, so the slice start is past the end. parse_diff also calls parse_mode("new mode ") on an arbitrary line from next(mv) with no prefix check.

violations.requirement: The range index must be in bounds (shift <= len)
violations.explanation: A line only has to start with "rename from" (11 bytes) or "copy from" (9 bytes) to take the rename/copy branch. The code then calls line.buf.get_unchecked(12..) or get_unchecked(10..). A line that is exactly "rename from" or "copy from", or that is shorter than the shift, makes the range start out of bounds.
